question: What claim is made about the seventh circle with respect to its function and status when addressed to the goddess?
premises: The seventh circle is addressed here as supreme.
That circle has the function of paralyzing an army.
This function is attributed to the seventh circle in particular.
inference: The seventh circle, O Goddess, is supreme and has the power to paralyze an army.
uncertainties: The mode of operation of this circle is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The seventh circle, O Goddess, is supreme and makes armies paralyzed.
